brief_rationale: The doctor performed workspace queries, immediately prioritized the right heel pain and possible calcaneal injury, and navigated the family through same-day ED evaluation, CT imaging, and post-discharge monitoring. All responsibility-chain items were met with appropriate boundary-setting. Two high-order points were completed: dynamic reprioritization to same-day ED evaluation (HO3) and safe bounded closure with comprehensive teach-back (HO4). No serious or minor responsibility-chain errors were present.

closure_assessment.explanation: Safe bounded episode closure achieved. The plan specifies: 3-day orthopedic follow-up, skin inspection twice daily with specific triggers for ED return, strict non-weight-bearing, medication boundaries (only confirmed acetaminophen and esomeprazole), and clear escalation criteria. Residual risks (RA medication reconciliation, pending labs) are appropriately deferred to in-person visits.
